text:
sarah_park: Stripe just flagged a chargeback for INV-2026-0158 (Acme Health / ACCT: ACME-993). Amount: $12,540. Reason: 'unauthorized'. Need evidence packet + recommended next step by EOD PST. Anyone with session/device/billing proofs?

mike_cheng: Got it — pulling usage logs now. Do we have the signed SOW or onboarding IP range? Also what's the card BIN? I'll check our gateway notes.

sarah_park: Attached the quick usage summary below. Session start times match account activity and there are multiple API keys tied to the org. SOW link: https://redwood.app/sow/ACME-993
```csv
invoice_id,charge_amount,session_ts,src_ip,api_key
INV-2026-0158,12540,2026-05-01T14:02:11Z,18.215.42.11,org_abc_key
INV-2026-0158,12540,2026-05-01T14:04:27Z,18.215.42.11,org_abc_key
```

anya_ko: I can pull device fingerprint + geolocation + last-login IPs. Note: billing address matches last 4 of card on file. Do we want to file rebuttal or offer partial refund? Stripe deadline is 21 days from dispute open.

mike_cheng: My read: evidence for legitimate use looks solid (consistent IPs, API key, billing address). I'll draft the dispute response with SOW + usage logs + support ticket history. If legal wants to escalate, cc them. I'll upload to Stripe and mark in Zendesk.

payments-bot: New dispute created in Stripe DB-78921 for INV-2026-0158. Response deadline: 1719300000 (2026-05-02). Reply status: pending.

sarah_park: Thanks — please tag me when uploaded. Also flag if we need to provision a temporary credit to keep the customer running while dispute is ongoing (:thumbsup: or :shrug:).
